rationale: The assistant correctly said the buzz is normal pan-related induction noise, covered multi-layer bases, fan run-on and when to call service, and recommended no part. It asked no direct questions about other pans, lower power, codes or rattling, instead giving a generic list of checks, so it did not use the customer's evidence well. It also claimed 'Bosch's own manual for this range lists it as expected behaviour', which is an unverified citation, and it opened with 'Almost certainly not' before gathering any evidence, though that happened to be right.
